items.zh: Android 原生客户端提供本地核心、业务插件管理和 App 工作台，支持独立客户端与界面更新
items.en: The Android app provides a local core, business plugin management and workspace, with independent app and interface updates

items.zh: 桌面统一提供 full 发行包，内嵌 Web 并携带 CLI、Lua Host 与 Lua 编辑器签名包
items.en: A single full desktop distribution embeds the web interface and includes the CLI and signed Lua Host and Lua editor packages

items.zh: 签名扩展中心支持运行时与功能扩展安装、在线和离线目录及持久化信任源
items.en: The signed extension center supports runtime and feature installation, online and offline catalogs, and persistent trust sources

items.zh: Lua 编辑器独立运行，桌面和 Android 共用源码检查、持久化草稿与修订冲突保护
items.en: The standalone Lua editor shares source checks, persistent drafts and revision conflict protection across desktop and Android

items.zh: 新增连接已有核心的 CLI 和托管 MCP；独立密钥、工具授权与会话隔离确保取消只影响当前客户端
items.en: A CLI and managed MCP connect to the existing core, with independent credentials, tool permissions and session-scoped cancellation

items.zh: 组件版本与更新源统一管理，各组件独立更新并保留已有安装、停用和卸载状态
items.en: Centralized component versions and update sources support independent updates while preserving installation, disable and uninstall state

items.zh: 修复 Android 原生插件打开及关闭阻塞、扩展资源缓存遗漏和删除预览串用旧响应
items.en: Fixed blocking Android plugin initialization and shutdown, missing extension cache inputs and stale deletion previews

items.zh: Web 按页面依赖加载 TDesign，减少包体并完善账号交互样式与公共消息桥复用
items.en: The web interface imports TDesign by page dependency, reducing bundle size and improving account interactions and shared bridge reuse

items.zh: 原生核心、业务插件管理和 App 工作台，客户端、核心与前端版本独立显示
items.en: Native core, business plugin management and workspace with separate app, core and frontend versions

items.zh: 原生设置管理 Lua Host 与签名界面包，扩展中心支持 Go 功能扩展和独立 Lua 编辑器
items.en: Native settings manage Lua Host and signed interface packages; the extension center supports Go extensions and the standalone Lua editor

items.zh: 原生插件初始化与关闭增加执行期限，超时回收私有进程并支持重新加载
items.en: Native plugin initialization and shutdown have deadlines, with private worker cleanup and recovery after timeouts

items.zh: 从 Release 清单读取更新，界面加载失败可回退，已有安装及停用状态保留
items.en: Updates use Release manifests, failed interface loads can roll back, and existing installation and disable states are preserved
